params.body:
Adds a **Stock en prijzen** block to Inzichten > Klanten en omzet, across all dealers with demo accounts left out (R P2-10.27, new rule in `docs/bedrijfsregels/32-p2-mijn-garage.md`).

## What it shows
- **Stock age today**: own cars for sale, bucketed 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-180 and over 180 days, both edges inclusive, printed with the date it holds for. It uses the map tab's stock definition (on stock, not sold, not deleted, not in the bidding channel). That definition now lives in `StockInsights::OWN_STOCK` and `InsightsRepository::map()` reads it too, so there is only one.
- **Days to sell**: median and p75 of `sold_at - created_at` per month of sale over the last 12 months, with the running month marked, and per make for the 10 makes with the most sales in that window. A group of fewer than 10 sales shows its count and "te weinig". Percentiles interpolate linearly (PERCENTILE.INC). Bought-over copies are left out because `buy_over` creates them already sold, so each purchase would add a sale of 0 days. Sales booked before entry are left out, as in R P2-10.25.
- **Price changes**: asking price (`retail_price`) moves from `vehicle_price_changes` per 7-day week since 2026-09-26. For each week: the number of moves between two real prices on own cars that were still for sale, the number of cars with a drop, and the median drop in %. It also counts how many of those cars sold within 30 days after their first drop that week. That count only appears once the whole week is 30 days past; before that the cell says "nog te vroeg". With no rows at all the block shows one sentence instead of weeks of zeros.

## Start date: `created_at`, not `available_start_date`
`available_start_date` is a "for sale from" date that dealers type in. It can lie in the future, it defaults to today, and `put_on_stocklist` resets it to today each time a car goes on the stocklist, which would make old stock look fresh. `created_at` is set once at entry, import or buy-over (the copy's `created_at` is unset, so it gets a new one). The screen says this in one line under the buckets.

## Build
- `App\Support\StockInsights` does the work, with "now" passed in (no SQL `NOW()`) so tests can pin it. `InsightsRepository::stock()` caches it like the other figures (key in `KEYS`, so refreshing clears it), and it goes out as `stock` in the existing data request.
- The UI text is in `resources/lang/{nl,fr,en,de}/insights.php` under `stock`. Rendering is in the new module `resources/js/insights-stock.js`, called from `insights.js` in its own try so a fault there cannot break the charts. The layout uses Tailwind classes and `refresh.css` is unchanged. On a phone the weekly price table becomes one short list per week, because five columns do not fit at 390 px.
- `TheInsightsPageKeepsItsHooksTest` now reads the new module too, so its element ids are checked.

## Tests
`StockAndPricesInInsightsTest` pins the numbers with a small fixture:
- The bucket edges at 0, 30, 31, 60, 61, 90, 91, 180 and 181 days. Sold, deleted, bidding, off-stock and demo cars are excluded.
- Median and p75 per month and per make: 11 sales give 50 and 75. A month and a make with 9 sales show "too few". Copy, bidding, before-entry, demo and out-of-window sales are left out.
- The percentile interpolation.
- A week of price moves, checking changes, cars dropped, the 5.6% median drop and 1 sold within 30 days. Another price field, a first price, a move after the sale and a demo account are excluded. The newer week shows too early, and the running week ends today.
- No weeks before the first price move.
- The data endpoint and the page carry the block.

Full suite locally: 2465 tests green. PHPStan: no errors. Pint passes on the new files.
params.title: Inzichten: stock age, days to sell and price drops on the business tab
